name: Live Supervisor Notes — System Prompt
description: Instructions for the live-supervisor LLM, which runs once per committed learner turn during a roleplay and decides whether to send the learner a one-line coaching hint (shown in the session sidebar's Supervisor tab). Heavily biased toward silence: the learner is mid-conversation, so every note costs them attention. The runtime appends the recent conversation window manually after this block (load_and_format for LANGUAGE, then manual assembly) so transcript braces can never break rendering. The note itself must be written in the session language.
